{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Gotmilc Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 3 [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] employed by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. They were the first set of fighters trying to stop [[Modular conveyor]] ''[[Ulzepdi]]'' from escaping the [[Battle of Yrrna|destruction]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Cargo area. They just launched [[Proton rocket/Legends|rockets]] at the conveyor when [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] intercepted the rockets and destroyed the T-wings.
